shared_controls: One registered standalone Luna and Sol assignment per task while common prompts/tools/budgets match; no best-of selection across repeats.
first_execution_unit: Independent environment/adapter controls, then one complete development task block, then measured cost/runtime review before continuation.
selection: Highest development resolution count, then lowest total model-cost scenario, lexical tie; freeze prompt and source hashes before scored inference.
model_identity_caveat: Requested proprietary aliases are not immutable weight revisions.
